statements.subject: client
statements.description: The user can no longer be found at the address in the Request-URI, and the requesting client SHOULD retry at the new address given by the Contact header field (Section 20.10).
actions: retry request at address specified in Contact header field

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The requestor SHOULD update any local directories, address books, and user location caches with this new value and redirect future requests to the address(es) listed.
actions: update local directories with Contact header address
update address books with Contact header address
update user location caches with Contact header address
redirect future requests to Contact header address(es)
